steps.title: Build your route in Google My Maps
steps.body: Drop pins, draw your route, and add stops in the My Maps editor you already know.

steps.body: Copy your My Maps share link into the trip form, then add the details: vehicle, duration, and where it goes.

steps.title: Share & discover
steps.body: Publish your trip for the community and explore map-backed routes other riders have shared.

featureHighlights.title: Everything you need to plan the next ride

items.body: Every trip embeds a real Google My Maps route — no vague itineraries, just the actual path on the map.

items.title: Save your favorites
items.body: Heart any route to build your own shortlist, then come back to it from your saved trips.

items.title: AI trip discovery
items.body: Describe the trip you want and let AI rank the community's routes down to the best matches.
